about: Helical H45AL 3-flute square end mill for aluminium, 3/8 x 1 x 2-1/2 in, modelled from scratch (no vendor CAD): a ground cross-section (cutting edge, margin, eccentric relief, the gullet) swept along the 45 deg helix, run out into the shank along the wheel's arc, the end dished with clearance facets; standing tip down as its placeholder does. Sources: Helical Solutions #03452 (H45AL-SR-30500) product page and images, helicaltool.com: 1/2 in, 3 flutes, 45 deg helix, 1 in LOC, 3 in OAL, ZPLUS; the images show ZPLUS gold over the flutes and a band past their runout, the shank bare ground carbide with a chamfered end. The record's model is the 1/2 in tool resized; this is Helical's own 3/8 in size.
reviewed: 2026-11-05: draft; flutes, runout and coating band checked against Helical's product images

em38_zplus.about: ZPLUS (Helical's pale-gold PVD coat) over the polished flutes

em38_zplus_land.about: ZPLUS over the ground lands, the end and the coated band past the runout

em38_carbide.about: bare cylindrical-ground tungsten carbide shank: greyer and darker than steel

tip down, as the placeholder stands (the Helical STEP's frame): a crib would usually stand it shank down; kept, since the frame is the placeholder's
